name: printerbot
tagline: Gives every bot in your fleet a matching 3D character portrait
description: Tell it what a bot is called and roughly what that bot does, and it renders a figure in the house style: a smooth pale head, dark capsule eyes, props hinting at the job, and a backdrop themed to the domain. The result is a consistent cast of avatars rather than a pile of mismatched images.
author: Federico
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
